faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the Ingenium AJ200D or AJ150D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. This engine was introduced in 2020 as a replacement for the previous D150 and D180 diesel badges.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport D165 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. The exact price depends on the condition of your engine and the parts required. Submit your registration for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my D165?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether your car has the AJ200D or AJ150D before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium diesel engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, and EGR components as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery Sport D165 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery Sport if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery Sport D165 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
